claims.claim: All Hyundai and Kia genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used.
claims.evidence: Witness only saw a headlight assembly; no make/model compatibility or inventory list was shown.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: No readable part number/brand marking was captured in the report; only lens/reflector/bulb holders were visible.
Witness noted a clear lens with internal reflectors and visible label text, but did not confirm absence of cracks/chips beyond what’s visible.
Mounting tabs/brackets condition was explicitly not shown/confirmed by the witness.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment/compatibility (Hyundai/Kia/Toyota mismatch or incorrect model/year/side), which can make the part unusable.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the headlight’s full part number/markings (including OEM code) and a matching vehicle fitment reference (e.g., VIN/model/year) or the exact side/position shown on the car.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used headlight assembly with uncertain fitment (buyer risk).

risks.risk: Not working (bulbs/holders, igniter/ballast if applicable, or internal wiring/connectors damaged).
risks.proof: A short video showing the headlight powered on (low/high beam and indicator/amber section if present) with the exact connector/wiring shown.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Hidden damage: cracks/chips, moisture ingress, lens clouding, or internal reflector damage not visible in the single laid-on-ground shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire lens perimeter and back housing, plus a flashlight/inspection view showing no moisture and no micro-cracks; also a photo of the back cover and any seal lines.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible hidden defects.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete components (covers, rubber seals/gaskets, adjuster mechanism, internal parts).
risks.proof: Photos showing the full assembly from multiple angles including the back side, rubber seals/gaskets, adjuster/leveling mechanism, and all included bulbs/covers.

risks.risk: Counterfeit/aftermarket (China copy) despite the seller’s claim.
risks.proof: Clear OEM markings/part number on the lens/back housing and (if possible) a matching OEM label/box receipt; also a photo of any manufacturer stamp.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the headlight’s OEM part number/markings on the lens and on the back housing (readable).
Send photos of the back side showing rubber seals/gaskets, mounting tabs/brackets, and the full connector/wiring area.
Send a short video powering the headlight to confirm it works (including the amber indicator section if applicable).
Send close-ups around the entire lens edge/perimeter to confirm no cracks/chips and no moisture inside.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a headlight assembly, but key pricing drivers (fitment, working status, completeness, and OEM authenticity) are not verifiable from the report. Without at least one proof item (part number/fitment and working test), a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
